protocol.status: Frozen before first SNN training run; one architecture and one hyperparameter setting
protocol.scope: Post-declared conventional SNN reference on already examined v1 synthetic and frozen SST holdouts; exploratory comparison
protocol.architecture: Single-layer recurrent leaky integrate-and-fire, spike-only low-pass readout, linear classifier
protocol.reset: Soft subtractive reset by one threshold; reset spike is stop_gradient; no refractory period
protocol.integration: Exponential leak per supplied dt with frozen current; at most one spike per supplied time bin
protocol.input_encoding: Same real-valued current input plus log1p(dt); no input/membrane bypass to output
protocol.state_scalars: 3 * width: membrane, prior spike, filtered spike
protocol.selection: Minimum validation cross entropy at updates 50,100,150,200,250,300
protocol.synthetic_data: Exactly original v1 dataset_suite(task,seed), verified by recorded per-split fingerprints
protocol.frozen_corruption: Gaussian sigma 0.15 plus 20% local feature-block dropout, full-sentence global feature always retained; not raw missing input
protocol.claim_limit: Dense CPU simulation; no neuromorphic, energy, SOTA, LLM or multimodal superiority inference

gradient_validation.interpretation: Backward matches the declared surrogate; it is not the true derivative of hard forward, so finite-difference equality is not claimed

metadata.comparison_status: Additional post-declared baseline on already examined holdouts; exploratory, not a new independent confirmation
metadata.timing_caveat: All timing fields are diagnostic; cache and shared CPU effects prevent speed/energy conclusions; old warm_training_seconds may include secondary JIT compilation
metadata.scope: Dense CPU reference simulation of hard-spiking neurons; no energy or neuromorphic hardware measurement
